title: AC/DC charges up Camp Randall
summary_en: The band's long-awaited return to Madison brought thousands of fans to campus for a night of classic hard rock anthems.

title: Miller named vice provost for enrollment management
summary_en: Ashley Miller will serve as UW–Madison's next vice provost for enrollment management and chief enrollment officer, effective Sept. 8.
